senses.gloss: स- + अधिष्ठान स- + अधिष्ठान, adj. having a solid base, ib.
स- + धनु स- + धनु, adj. with a bow (in his hand).
स- + धनुस् स- + धनुस्, adj. armed with a bow.
स- + धर्मन् स- + धर्मन्, adj. 1. equal in respect of duty, Man. 10, 41. 2. of the same caste, performing like duties. 3. of the same properties. 4. Like.

स- + धर्मिन् स- + धर्मिन्,
 I. adj. Observing the same customs or laws.
 II. f. इणी, A wife wedded according to the ritual of the Vedas.
स-धवा स-धवा, f. a wife whose husband is living.

साधु- + धी साधु- + धी,
 I. adj. well-disposed.
 II. f. a wife's or husband's mother.
साधु- + भाव साधु- + भाव, m. goodness, Brāhmaṇav. 1, 4.
साधु- + मत साधु- + मत, adj. praised, Chr. 56, 12.
साधन- + रूपिन् साधन- + रूपिन्, adj. having the form or caracter of expedients, Vedāntas. in Chr. 219, 9.
साधु- + वाह साधु- + वाह, m. a well-trained horse.
साधु- + वाहिन् साधु- + वाहिन्, m. a well-trained horse.

साधु- + वृत्त साधु- + वृत्त,
 I. m. a virtuous person, Hit. i. d. 201, M.M.
 II. n. virtue.

साधु- + वृत्ति साधु- + वृत्ति,
 I. f. the institutes or moral and ritual observances of the Hindus.
 II. adj. virtuous, Bhartṛ. 2, 83.
साधु- + शब्द साधु- + शब्द, m. a cry of ‘Good.’
साधु- + शील साधु- + शील, adj. virtuous.
सधिस् सधिस्, m. An ox.

सध्र्यञ्च् सध्र्यञ्च्, i. e. स + त्रा-अञ्च् (त् changed to ध्, by the influence of र्, and आ̆ to ई, in analogy with the change of final आ̆ before अस्, कृ, भू),
 I. adj., f. रीची, Accompanying, a companion.
 II. f. रीची, A woman's female friend.
 III. ˚यक्, adv. Together with, Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 48 (united with themselves).
साधु- + समाचार साधु- + समाचार, adj. wellbehaved, Pañc. 41, 17.

साध् साध् (i. e. probably सो-धा), ii. 5, Par.
 1. To finish, to accomplish.
 2. To conquer, Hit. iii. d. 40.
 --† i. 4, Par. To be completed or accomplished (cf. सिध्).
 --Caus. (also of सिध्, q. cf.),
 1. To bring to a conclusion, to accomplish, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 24; Hit. i. d. 1.
 2. To prepare for heaven, Man. 2, 248.
 3. To secure, Man. 7, 173.
 4. To effect, to perform, MBh. 5, 117.
 5. To overcome, Hit. 59, 21; to conquer, MBh. 1, 7435; to kill, Pañc. 211, 12.
 6. To obtain, Man. 6, 75.
 7. To recover a debt, Man. 8, 176.
 8. To learn, Ragh. 10, 29.
 9. To set out, to go away, Śāk. 7, 19; to fly, Mālat. 126, 5; to proceed, Vikr. 60, 13.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. साधित.
 1. Accomplished, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 24.
 2. [] Mastered, Kathās. 46, 118; obtained, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 11.
 3. Successful, Lass. 3, 16.
 4. Recovered (as a debt).
 5. Fulfilled, discharged.
 6. Punished, Pañc. 257, 4; punished by fine.
 7. Awarded (as the thing or fine).
 8. Awarded to or in favour of (as the person to whom the fine is to be paid).
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. साध्य.
 1. What must or will be accomplished, Hit. pr. d. 1.
 2. Practicable, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 23.
 3. Conquerable, Pañc. i. d. 244.
 4. To be mastered, Pañc. i. d. 73; Śiś. 5, 49.
 5. Able to be destroyed, Pañc. 194, 19.
 6. To be inferred or concluded, Bhāṣāp. 137.
 7. To be cured, curable. m. A class of inferior deity, Man. 3, 195. n.
 1. Accomplishment, perfection.
 2. (In logic), The major term in a syllogism, Siddh. Mukt. 62, 3.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. उप उप, उपसाधित, Subdued, Pañc. iii. d. 249.
 --With परि परि, Caus. To settle, Man. 8, 187.
 --With प्र प्र, Caus.
 1. To further, Pañc. i. d. 407.
 2. To accomplish, Pañc. i. d. 140.
 3. To dress, Śāk. 49, 21.
 4. To acquire, Pañc. i. d. 2.
 5. To subdue, Man. 7, 103. प्रसाधित,
 1. Accomplished, done.
 2. Ornamented, decorated, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 10. प्रसाध्य,
 1. What may be done.
 2. To be destroyed, defeated.
 --Comp.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, Caus. To settle, Hit. iv. d. 117. []
 --With सम् सम्, Caus.
 1. Ātm. To be successful, MBh. 3, 1478.
 2. To endow with, Rām. 2, 36, 9.
 3. To destroy, MBh. 3, 1683.
 4. To extinguish, MBh. 1, 2841.
 5. To obtain, Man. 2, 100.
 6. To cause to be paid, 8, 213.
 7. To regain, 8, 50.
 --Cf. probably Goth. sandjan; A.S. sendan.

साधक साध् + अक,
 I. adj., f. धिका,
 1. Accomplishing.
 2. Helping, Indr. 5, 56.
 3. Magical, Pañc. 241, 2; an adept, Mālat. 74, 6; 9, 7 (Prākṛ.).
 II. f. इका, Deep sleep (= सुषुप्ति, a vedantic term).
 --Comp.

साधन साध् + अन, n.
 1. Accomplishing, Hit. iv. d. 98 (साध्य-, What must be accomplished, i. e. one's aim).
 2. Advancement, Man. 4, 196.
 3. A means of accomplishing, Pañc. i. d. 8.
 4. Wealth.
 5. A part of an army, Utt. Rāmac. 39, 12.
 6. Instrument.
 7. Cause, efficient cause, Man. 11, 237; source of prosperity, Man. 12, 100.
 8. Subduing by charms, Pañc. 241, 2.
 9. Killing, destroying, Kir. 14, 17.
 10. Obsequies.
 11. Authority.
 12. Proof, substantiation.
 13. The हेतु or middle term in an inference.
 14. Enforcement of the delivery of anything, of payment, especially juridically, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 20; 185, 21.
 15. Medicament, drug.
 16. Matter, materials, that of which anything is composed.
 17. Substance, thing.
 18. The penis, Sāh. D. 212, 19.
 19. Going.
 20. Following, profit, Pañc. 86, 24.
 21. Good works, Windischmann, Sankara, 97.
 22. Friendship.
 --Comp.
साध्य- + साधन साध्य- + साधन, n. effecting what is to be done, Hit. iv. d. 98.

साधनता साधन + ता, f., and साधनत्व साधन + त्व, n. State or condition of being a means to a desired end, Bhāṣāp. 146 (त्व); 147 (ता).
 --Comp.
साधन्त साधन्त् + अ (vb. साध्), m. A beggar.

साधर्म्य साधर्म्य, i. e. स-धर्म + य,
 1. Community, equality, of duty, Vikr. 65, 12.
 2. Community of properties, common character, Bhāṣāp. 12. 28; likeness, Kusumāñj. 3, 9.

साधारण साधारण, i. e. स-धारण + अ, adj.
 1. Belonging to many, common, Bhāṣāp. 71; equal, Vikr. d. 34.
 2. Like, similar, Lass. 85, 10.
 --Comp.
साधारणत्व साधारण + त्व, and साधारण्य साधारण्य, i. e. साधारण + य, n. Community, universality, general law, Journ. of the German Oriental Society, ix. xxxix. 10.
साधिमन् साधिमन्, i. e. साधु + इमन्, m. Goodness, excellence.
साधिष्ठ साधिष्ठ, साधीयंस् साधियंस्, see वाढ and the next.

साधु साध् + उ,
 I. adj., f. धु and ध्वी, comparat. साधीयंस्, superl. साधिष्ठ,
 1. Perfect, Śāk. d. 2.
 2. Fit, proper, right.
 3. Good, Hit. i. d. 11, M.M.; kind, Pañc. iv. d. 72; virtuous, pure.
 4. Excellent.
 5. Beautiful, pleasing.
 II. acc. sing. धु, adv.
 1. Well, Śāk. d. 11; Vikr. 6, 6.
 2. Indeed, Vikr. 20, 9.
 3. With instr., prohibiting, Enough, away with, Pañc. v. d. 40.
 III. m.
 1. A Muni or sage.
 2. An honest man, Pañc. 67, 6.
 3. A usurer, Hit. 111, 1; a merchant, Hit. 65, 9.
 IV. f. धु and ध्वी, A chaste, virtuous woman.
 --Comp.

साधुता साधु + ता, f., and साधुत्व साधु + त्व, n.
 1. Correctness, Utt. Rāmac. 4, 10 (त्व).
 2. Goodness, Pañc. i. d. 277 (त्व); Daśak. in Chr. 187, 23 (ता).
 --Comp.
साधुंमन्य साधुंमन्य, i. e. साधु + म्-मन् + य, adj. Thinking one's self virtuous.
साधुशीलत्व साधु-शील + त्व, n. Virtuous disposition, Hit. i. d. 85, M.M.

साध्य साध्य,
 1. See साध्.
 2. i. e. साध्य + अ, adj. Belonging to the Sādhyas, a class of inferior deity, Arj. 4, 30.
साध्यता साध्य + ता, f. in अ-, State of not being able to be overcome, Pañc. i. d. 245.

साध्यवन्त् साध्य + वन्त् (vb. साध्),
 I. adj., f. वती, Comprehending that which is to be proved.
 II. m. (In law), The party on whom rest the onus probandi.
 III. n. That in which the साध्य or major term resides (i. e. the पक्ष and its सपक्षऽस्), Bhāṣāp. 67; 73.

साध्वस साध्वस, probably स-ध्वंस् + अ + अ, n.
 1. Fear, terror, Vikr. d. 56; Mālav. 20, 9; 53, 21; Śāk. 12, 21.
 2. Perturbation, Bhāg. P. 1, 11, 19.
 3. Torpor, Utt. Rāmac. 80, 10.
 --Comp.
साध्य- + सिद्धि साध्य- + सिद्धि, f. 1. completion. 2. establishing what is to be proved.
